ownership_rule: User rule 2026-09-25: the project owns this database; no application (Ingest, Media Assist, Story or any other) owns it or its tables. No form writes to it, so none can own it: data made in an application reaches these tables only through the intermediary, the one public writer of the project database, qnc.module.content-store.
